# 圓覺經要解

**ID:** X0260
**Volume:** X10
**Category:** 經集部類
**Original Category:** 大小乘釋經部／方等部疏
**Byline:** 明 寂正要解
**Dynasty:** 明
**Date:** 1368–1644
**Juans:** 2
**CBETA:** https://cbetaonline.dila.edu.tw/zh/X0260

## Contributors
- 寂正 (A001027)

## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A 2-fascicle compact commentary on the *Yuánjué jīng* ([KR6i0551](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0551)) by the late-Míng monk [寂正](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%AF%82%E6%AD%A3) Jìzhèng 寂正 of the Lùtōng Lǜsì 陸通律寺 in Wǔlín 武林 (Hángzhōu). The work is a *yàojiě* 要解 — "essential explication" — that distils the developed Zōngmì-tradition exegesis into a brief, classroom-friendly format, comparable in scope and intent to the contemporary [通潤](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E9%80%9A%E6%BD%A4) Tōngrùn *Yuánjué jīng jìnshì* ([KR6i0570](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0570)) but with a more pronounced *vinaya*-school inflection consonant with the author's institutional affiliation. Each chapter of the sūtra is given a short summary outline followed by line-by-line explanatory glosses; the work is consciously economic, omitting most of the elaborate doctrinal-classification apparatus that the Sòng commentaries had inherited from Zōngmì.

**Abstract**

The autograph preface, preserved at the head of the work (X10 no. 260), is dated 大明萬曆丁巳佛成道日 = the Buddha's enlightenment day (12/8) of Míng Wànlì 45 = early 1618 CE; signed *Wǔlín shì* Jìzhèng 武林釋寂正. The signature line at the head of the main text further identifies him as *Lùtōnglǜsì qínxī* 陸通律寺勤息 — i.e., a *vinaya*-school monk (*lǜsì* = "*vinaya*-monastery") in Hangzhou's Lùtōngsì, with the self-deprecatory *qínxī* 勤息 ("diligent rest") as monastic title. The dating places the work in the late-Wàn-lì period, contemporary with [德清](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%BE%B7%E6%B8%85) Hānshān Déqīng's [KR6i0569](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0569) *Zhíjiě* (composed 1606–1623) and [通潤](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E9%80%9A%E6%BD%A4) Tōngrùn's [KR6i0570](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0570) *Jìnshì* (composed before 1624). Together these three constitute the Wǎn Míng efflorescence of *Yuánjué* exegesis.

The work is otherwise undocumented; Jìzhèng's lifedates and detailed biographical information are not preserved in standard reference works. He was clearly part of the late-Wàn-lì Hángzhōu *vinaya*-revival circle but his place within that movement cannot be reconstructed from the available evidence.
